{{DATA_NOTES}}
  • This report shows only the search trace exposed in this response. It does not reveal the complete internal search process or describe other runs.
  • Exposed-query counts include duplicates; unique queries are deduplicated by their full text. Search sources and cited URLs are counted independently.
  • Unexposed queries are never inferred or reconstructed. Domains retain subdomains rather than being grouped under a parent domain.
  • Citation offsets refer to the original text blocks in raw-response.json, not to this report's HTML.
